SMTO-LLM-0091 — This model service uses a request format SMTO can't use

GUID: 80f83ca2-fcd5-4d7a-987f-bab2565320fe
Slug: provider-api-incompatible
Domain: LLM · Subsystem: readiness

What happened

  • The address set for this model leads to a service that expects a different kind of request than SMTO sends, so SMTO can't get answers from it.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Open Settings › Setup › Model routing and look at the Endpoint on the card for the model that failed (Main, Helper or Vision). The Endpoint is the address SMTO sends model requests to, and this error means that address expects a different format.
  2. Ask the person who runs the model service for its OpenAI-compatible address (it usually ends in /v1). Enter it as the Endpoint and select Save for that card, for example Save Main. SMTO only sends OpenAI-style Chat Completions requests, so it needs an address that accepts them.
  3. Select Check saved model on the same card. It confirms the new address answers SMTO's requests before you start more work.
  4. Before asking SMTO to continue a task that stopped with this error, open its Conversation and check which steps it already finished. Steps finished before the error may already have made changes, and repeating them could do them twice.

What success looks like

  • Check saved model completes without this error, and new tasks get answers from the model.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who runs the model service, and ask whether it offers a Chat Completions address or a compatible proxy. Don't turn off sign-in or certificate checks to make the connection work.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The provider returned an unsupported_api or unsupported_endpoint error code, so the configured endpoint does not offer the OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions API that SMTO requires.

What this means

  • This SMTO client sends OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions requests. A native provider or Responses-only endpoint uses a different request and response contract. A port responding successfully is not evidence of API compatibility.

Why this can happen

  • This SMTO client sends OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions requests. A native provider or Responses-only endpoint uses a different request and response contract. A port responding successfully is not evidence of API compatibility.

How to diagnose it

  • The configured service cannot provide the required Chat Completions interface.
  • The core compatibility check completes through the configured Chat Completions route.

How to fix it

  • Set the role's base URL to an OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoint (usually ending in /v1), or put a compatible proxy in front of a native or Responses-only API. Verify with Check saved model, and inspect existing operation receipts before resuming saved work.
  • Configure a supported OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions base URL or a compatible proxy. Do not point this client at a native or Responses-only API.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded condition before trying the affected request again. Inspect existing operation receipts before resuming saved work.

How to verify the fix

  • The core compatibility check completes through the configured Chat Completions route.

What not to do

  • Do not replay completed work or weaken authentication and certificate checks to clear this diagnostic.

Technical notes

  • The diagnostic describes the observed failure; it does not establish the outcome of earlier operations.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
